threads.body: `.github/actionlint.yaml` declares `cncf-ubuntu-2-8-x86` under `self-hosted-runner.labels`, but these workflows use the label alone in `runs-on`. For self-hosted runners, it’s more robust to be explicit and use the array form (e.g., `runs-on: [self-hosted, cncf-ubuntu-2-8-x86]`, and in the matrix `os: [self-hosted, cncf-ubuntu-2-8-x86]`). This avoids ambiguity and aligns with typical self-hosted runner selection patterns.
